title: Graph Simulation Request
description: Graph simulation request sent to the NetVigil XR security simulation engine (Rust/WASM). Contract version 1.0. Supports two independent graph computations: network reachability and service dependency impact.

contract_version.description: Must be exactly "1.0". The Rust engine performs authoritative validation and rejects any other value.

request_id.description: Non-empty ASCII identifier, maximum 256 characters. Used to correlate requests with responses.

scenario_id.description: Non-empty ASCII identifier, maximum 64 characters. Must start with an alphanumeric character and may subsequently contain alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', ':', or '-'.

assets.description: List of assets in the scenario. Maximum 256 entries.

id.description: Unique asset identifier. Must start with an alphanumeric character and may subsequently contain alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', ':', or '-'. Maximum 64 characters.

availability.description: Availability state of the asset. Must be "available" or "unavailable".

network_edges.description: List of directed, typed network relationships. Maximum 2,048 entries.

id.description: Unique network edge identifier. Identifier grammar, maximum 64 characters.

source_asset_id.description: Source asset identifier. Must reference an existing asset ID.

target_asset_id.description: Destination asset identifier. Must reference an existing asset ID.

enabled.description: Whether the network edge is traversable (true) or blocked (false).

service_dependencies.description: List of required service dependencies. Direction: dependent_asset_id depends on dependency_asset_id. Maximum 2,048 entries.

id.description: Unique service dependency identifier. Identifier grammar, maximum 64 characters.

dependent_asset_id.description: Asset that requires the dependency. Must reference an existing asset ID.

dependency_asset_id.description: Asset being depended upon. Must reference an existing asset ID.

attack_source_asset_ids.description: List of initially compromised asset IDs from which modeled reachability is calculated. Empty list is permitted. Duplicate values are rejected. Maximum 256 entries.

items.description: Asset identifier. Must reference an existing asset ID.

versioning_rules: The contract_version field is the authoritative version indicator. Must be "1.0".
The Rust engine rejects any contract_version it does not recognize.
New contract versions require a new schema file and a new Rust validation branch.
TypeScript adapters must not send a contract_version the Rust engine does not accept.
error_behavior: Missing or invalid request_id → INVALID_REQUEST_ID error.
Missing or invalid scenario_id → INVALID_SCENARIO_ID error.
Duplicate directed network relationship → DUPLICATE_NETWORK_RELATIONSHIP error.
Excessively large input collection → LIMIT_EXCEEDED error.
Attack source references missing asset → UNKNOWN_ASSET_REFERENCE error.
Attack source references unavailable asset → SOURCE_ASSET_UNAVAILABLE error.
All errors return a JSON object with { code, message } fields.
